description:
Use Switcheroo to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat from step 2.
